_about: Every brand value the River Fox tools draw with, in one place. Each block says what it is about ('subject': covers, review cards, safe areas...), never which board it sits on, because Matt reorganises the boards often. The live Brand Pack artifact is the source: at the start of every social job read the pack's rules for what the job makes and, if a value has changed, change the matching block here before building. Never write a version of the pack here or anywhere else. Values marked 'toolOwn' are not written on the pack; they are how the tool applies a rule the pack leaves open. Never write a brand value into a tool or the skill. Pixel values are at a 1080-wide frame unless a block says otherwise.

handle.subject: the handle on covers and video

type.subject: covers: the headline type
type.line2: italic, the same size as line 1

toolOwn.note: fitWidth 888 on feed posts keeps the 96px edge clear (Brand sheet rule 07). minPx: below this the hook is too long to set big; shorten it or move words to the capitals line instead of shrinking the headline.

4x5.subject: covers: Facebook post cover layout (the pack draws it 1440 wide)

blocks.subject: covers: colour blocks for faces and busy spots
blocks.when: Only when the words of a normal cover would land on a face or a busy spot. A one-word hook keeps the normal big headline.
blocks.line2: italic, the same size as line 1 (every line after the first)

place.personToCamera: centre the stack between the top of the grid view (safeArea.coverGrid.y0) and halfway down the forehead: over hair and the upper forehead, above the eyes
place.rule: anywhere the photo is calmest, placed by eye (not one fixed height every time, or the grid looks too symmetrical), centred across; never on a face, logo or sign. The grid crops 240px off the top and bottom and the reel icon sits top right, so a block at 240px is cut off.

blocks.handleAndFade: the normal cover handle (cover.layout.9x16) and the normal fade (cover.fade)
blocks.handleOnFace: leave it off: if the handle at its fixed spot would land on a face (her chin), the cover has no handle

toolOwn.note: --shift (moving the photo down so a head clears the stack) came from an earlier version of the pack, which no longer shows it, so it is the tool's own option. shiftFadePx and shiftBlurPx: the photo's top fades over 340px into a blurred strip. shiftFillFrom: the top 12% of the photo is what gets stretched into that space, so no ghost of the subject shows. faceMargin widens the face box Apple Vision finds by 15% each way (used for the handle); browMargin: blocks stop 4% of the face's height above the eyebrows. reelIconInGrid: where Instagram's Reel icon sits on a profile-grid tile (measured on the 3:4 crop, 1080 wide), with 16px kept clear around it; the board's 340px line alone does not keep a wide first block off it.

videoText.subject: headline and closing text on video

toolOwn.note: 760 leaves room for the letters' own overhang inside the 800 limit
